sources.title: EphAsad/Satella-30B-A3B · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Satella-30B-A3B is the large sparse reasoning branch of the Atem model series. It begins from the already post-trained Qwen/Qwen3-30B-A3B checkpoint and preserves the base model's native dual-mode reasoning behaviour rather than erasing and rebuilding it in separate stages.
